title: Chapter 1084
text:
"Mission time …"

Han Xiao glanced at the interface and immediately knew what was going on.

According to the basic reward, it should not be difficult for Hella to take over the Underworld dimension. It was just that the additional requirements would be more difficult. Who knew how much energy it would take to restore this tattered Underworld to its original state? Even squeezing Hella dry would not be enough.

However, since it was an inheritance from a senior, there was no reason to reject it. At most, it would take more time.

The [Brand of the Underworld] made Han Xiao quite envious. Its effect was to gain the right to control the energy of the secondary dimension to a certain extent. This thing was equivalent to a kind of control authority, similar to the Mark of Evil Convergence on Traveler. It was the key to opening the secondary dimension and also gave some strength bonuses.

Furthermore, when he killed an enemy, he could also drag the enemy's soul into the Underworld and increase the number of members in the 'Martyr's Palace'. It was equivalent to gaining part of Hella's authority and becoming a part-time Soul Hunter.

Connecting this to the Favorability reward, could it be that he had done Onicelu a huge favor, so she was willing to give her body to him?

Thinking about it this way, it did seem quite exciting …

Han Xiao recalled that in his previous life, Hella did not display any ability related to the Underworld dimension. The Underworld had probably already disappeared before she discovered it.

After all, the opportunity for Hella to discover the Underworld dimension was the process of establishing a life link with Aurora. The Underworld acted as a medium and intercepted most of the energy transmitted between the two. Without this wave of energy, Onicelu would not have been able to wake up.

In his previous life, Aurora was already dead, and Hella was alone. Since there was no energy transmission between the two sisters, she most likely did not discover the existence of the Underworld dimension and missed out on the inheritance.

At the same time, without Aurora, there was no way to summon an Underworld powerhouse like the Edo Tensei, and the recovery energy from the fusion of the two did not exist. Thus, even if Hella obtained the Underworld dimension, she would only be able to use a weakened version of it …

Therefore, in the end, the Germinal Organization leader was really amazing.

Various thoughts flashed through Han Xiao's mind. Finally, he calmed himself down and nodded at Onicelu.

"Alright, I'll bring them over immediately to meet you."

"It's all up to you." Onicelu smiled.

After she finished speaking, her figure disappeared, concealing the dimensional consciousness entity once again. She had already said what she needed to say. Now that her dimensional energy was completely depleted, she would save as much as she could.

Now that only the two of them were left, Han Xiao turned to look at Ames and saw that she was deep in thought. It was obvious that she had not recovered from the shock yet.

This was understandable. The two of them only wanted to help Hella scout the area, but they didn't expect to encounter a series of unforeseen events. First, he met the Traveler and beat him up. Then, he was ambushed by an unknown army. Clottey went missing, and the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy was crippled. Finally, he met the dimensional consciousness entity of the Underworld and learned such shocking secrets. There was too much information to digest.

It was said that every lucky guy seemed to have a physique that caused trouble easily. Why didn't he see Ames's potential in this aspect before?

However, overall, Han Xiao was more surprised than shocked. He had captured the Holy Light Particle, triggered many new missions, and obtained some secret intelligence. He had gained a lot.

Although a part of the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy was taken away, it could still use its abilities. Thinking about it this way, it did not seem like he had lost anything.

As for the pain of the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy, Han Xiao was actually not too concerned … Lu Zizhen had really said this time that the joys and sorrows of people were not the same, let alone people and Esper Ability Entities.

Dealing with the Holy Covenant organization required long-term planning. The most important thing now was to help Hella inherit the Underworld.

Thinking about that, Han Xiao patted Ames's shoulder and said, "Stop spacing out. It's time to leave."

Ames came back to her senses and smiled happily.

"I didn't expect Hella and Aurora to have such fortuitous encounters. As expected of my students."

"Yes, yes, yes. Your students are amazing."

Seeing that Ames had entered her disciple-obsessed mode again, Han Xiao helplessly interrupted her and said, "Since we've encountered such a situation, we have to stop our trip. I'll get the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy to bring you back to Black Star Palace and bring Hella over. You don't have any objections, right?"

"This is great news. Why would I have any objections?" Ames chuckled.

Hearing this, Han Xiao nodded and ordered the Mysterious Energy Host to grab Ames, disappearing without a trace in a flash. The Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy's Dimensional Travel ability was much more convenient than mechanical devices, so it did not take much time to go back and forth.

Leaving him alone to wait, he thought for a while before opening the communication channel and calling the dynasty's secondary dimension outpost. This time, he contacted the dynasty's guardian here.

After a while, the communication was finally connected, and Guzar's face appeared before him.

The moment he saw this face, Han Xiao was stunned for a moment.

Eh, Zhang Fei?

Oh, I saw wrongly. Scared me. This is too similar. It's like they're made from the same mold …

This time, Guzar's loud voice sounded, and his tone was impatient.

"Black Star, I suddenly lost the location of the Dark Emperor. Where did he go?"

"We were attacked by a mysterious fleet, and he was exiled into space turbulence …" Han Xiao briefly explained the process, emphasizing the Holy Covenant's technology.

"This group of small fries actually made him suffer? Clottey is really getting worse and worse, "Guzar grumbled unhappily.

"Understandable, understandable …" Han Xiao coughed and tried to change the topic.

Guzar shook his beard and murmured, "However, this group of people's technology is indeed unique. If I was not prepared, I might have ended up like them … Hey, Black Star, do you know where they came from?"

"I don't know. If you want to track them down, I suggest the dynasty start with the records of the birth of Primal Esper Ability Entities. This organization must have more than one Primal Esper Ability Entity. I don't know about the rest."

This time, he was not deliberately hiding it. Han Xiao's understanding of the Holy Covenant of this era was indeed limited. Just exposing the organization's name would not have much effect, and it would only attract suspicion.

"Got it. I will upload your information. This group of people actually dared to attack the dynasty. We must dig them out and teach them a lesson," Guzar said in a deep voice.

Han Xiao nodded secretly.

Letting the dynasty track down the Holy Covenant organization would at least cause some trouble for the other party.

With the power of an advanced civilization, they might really discover something. This could be considered as him taking advantage of the situation.

Guzar cursed a few times and vented some of his anger before calming down. He sized up Han Xiao's figure and could not help but extend a warm invitation.

"Black Star, I've always wanted to get to know you. Come visit me when you have time. Let's get to know each other better."

"There will be a chance."

Han Xiao agreed with a smile on the surface, but he sighed in his heart.

A powerful Beyond Grade A taking the initiative to befriend him meant that he was finally about to succeed in getting to know him after so many years.

He had an impression of Guzar. This was a dynasty expert who guarded the secondary dimensions all year round, and he had never met him personally before. In Han Technician's memory, this guy seemed to be very good at fighting. It was a pity that he died a little too early and did not make it to the World Tree version.

Speaking of which, the secondary dimensions were also one of the battlefronts of the World Tree war. The degree of devastation here was not inferior to that of the main universe. The research institutes and outposts of the three Universal Civilizations in the secondary dimensions were almost completely wiped out. Compared to the stable spacetime and style of the main universe, the bizarre secondary dimensions were more dangerous due to their endless changes.

After chatting for a while, the two parties got along quite well and left a good impression on each other.

Han Xiao hung up the communication. The space around him fluctuated again, and the Mysterious Energy Host brought Ames and Hella back to Han Xiao's side.

He turned around and greeted them.

"Yo, you're here. Why didn't you bring your sister along?"

"There's no need to bring Aurora to such a dangerous place. I need her ability, so I'll just get her to transmit it to me remotely." Hella explained. She then looked around, curiously sizing up the Underworld Dimension, and suspiciously said, "You guys really didn't team up to lie to me? This secondary dimension is the legacy of the Primordial Ones? "

"Let her explain it to you herself."

Han Xiao snapped his fingers and almost subconsciously called him Geezer Earth.

Onicelu appeared again. She first smiled at Han Xiao, as if praising his efficiency. Then, she pulled the doubtful Hella aside and started talking.

Seeing this, Han Xiao called out to Hella and said, "Alright, let's talk to her for now.

"Alright, you can talk to her slowly. Ames and I won't stay here to accompany you. We'll leave you with a mechanical army. If there's anything, just inform me. You have the King mechanical suit anyway. Just call me if you're in danger, and I'll teleport you back."

Hila turned around and looked at him. After hesitating for a moment, she nodded. "Okay, you go and play with your teacher."

Han Xiao smiled at her, then let the Mysterious Energy Host take the two of them and disappear.

He was not worried about Hella's safety. After all, she was a Beyond Grade A, and she had his own army to take care of her. She had enough power to protect herself in the secondary dimensions.

Looking in the direction where the two of them disappeared, Hella had complicated emotions in her eyes.

There was both joy and disappointment.

The legacy of the Primordial Ones was an opportunity to increase her strength, so she was naturally very surprised.

However, when she thought about how the two-person trip she had agreed to with Black Star in the secondary dimensions would be canceled, Hella felt a little disappointed.

Although she did not usually say it, she actually really wanted to go out and play with Black Star …

…

Void Dimension.

A red light flashed, and the two of them instantly appeared in Kirkmond's territory.

After settling the business of the Holy Light Particle and the Underworld Dimension, Han Xiao planned to complete the [Void Conqueror] milestone mission. Therefore, he remembered his agreement with Kirkmond and rushed back.

However, at this moment, the two of them looked around and could not help but be slightly stunned.

The void crystal floating city, which was originally densely populated, was now empty. The Void Corps stationed here were all gone.

"Strange, where did they all go? Did they go out to train?" Ames looked around.

"We'll know once we find a void creature and ask."

Han Xiao brought Ames to Kirkmond's palace. As expected, there were still some void attendants who did not have much combat power left. When they saw the two distinguished guests that their lord had received, they all came forward to welcome them.

Han Xiao did not stand on ceremony and asked directly, "Where did Kirkmond go?"

"His Lordship led the army out to war."

"Didn't we tell him to wait for us to return before starting the war? Could he not even wait for this little bit of time?" Han Xiao was puzzled.

The void attendant said helplessly, "It wasn't Lord Kirkmond who started the war. It was the other void lords who invaded us, and Lord Kirkmond was only forced to fight."

"Then give me the coordinates of the battlefield." Han Xiao narrowed his eyes and said in a low voice, "It seems like we came at the right time."

…

At the same time, in a certain area of the Void Dimension, two massive void armies were engaged in a fierce battle.

In the middle of the battlefield, the leading void lords of both sides were killing each other.

One of them was riding a young void dragon, holding a giant void crystal shield and a black longsword. The other was riding a void worm with more than 20 arms, all of which were holding bronze short spears.

Every time the weapons of both sides clashed, there would be a burst of bluish-purple void energy shockwaves. A large area around them was emptied out, and no one came to interfere with the duel between the two void lords.

The one wielding the longsword was Kirkmond. He was at a slight disadvantage in the duel. His control of void energy was not as profound as his opponent's, and his ability was also much weaker. He was in a rather passive position, attacking less and defending more.

The enemy he was facing was his nemesis, Han Xiao's mission target, Void Lord Bagdora.

As they were all void creatures, they had high resistance to void energy, which limited the effectiveness of long-range attacks. Thus, most void creatures were more inclined to close combat when dealing with their own kind.

Clang!

More than 10 short spears slashed down at the same time. Kirkmond hurriedly raised his shield to block, and a ring-shaped shockwave exploded at the point of collision. Both sides were in a stalemate.

"Can you feel my increased strength? You're no longer my opponent!" Bagdora laughed loudly.

"You killed another Void Overlord?!" Kirkmond was both shocked and furious.

At their level, every increase in strength was very important. Only by devouring existences of the same level or higher would their strength increase significantly.

For many years, both of them were evenly matched, but now, Bagdora's strength was obviously higher. This could only be explained by him devouring the core of another void lord.

"Hmph, a newly born void lord happened to pass by my territory, so I turned him into my nutrients. This is fate. I'm destined to defeat you!"

"Damn it!" Kirkmond was instantly envious. Why couldn't he encounter such a good thing?

Bagdora stabbed his short spear so hard that it left afterimages. His mental fluctuations were filled with impatience. He had already treated Kirkmond as a nutritious meal and could not wait to devour him.

"As long as I devour you, I'll be able to enter the ranks of the upper level lords. Resistance is useless. Be obedient and become my food!"

Kirkmond could not withstand the enemy's ferocious charge, and it became more and more difficult for him to defend. He was surrounded by danger, and the army around him was also showing signs of weakness.

He knew that if this continued, he would definitely lose. He could not help but shout angrily.

"Don't be smug! I still have reinforcements! "

"So what if you have reinforcements? Do you think I'll be scared away by you?"

Bagdora laughed maniacally and used his short spear to cut off a small piece of Kirkmond's body.

"I'll eat your so-called reinforcements as well. They'll be the nourishment you're giving me!"

At this moment, Han Xiao's figure happened to appear at the edge of the battlefield. Hearing this, he could not help but turn to look at this void lord. His eyebrows twitched.

He released a wide-area mental message that suddenly swept across the battlefield.

"You want to try?"
